note: S17.4 sub-case (a vacant cell cedes its whole extent). The same 2-cell scene, but the RIGHT cell (1:1:0) is a RESERVED SLOT (reserved:true, contents:[] — rebind's empty arm). Drag v@500 by delta=+400 toward the vacant cell (coord 500->900). _cell_min on a vacant/reserved cell composes P::subtree_min over an EMPTY min_size {} → P::leaf_fit_min defaults each axis to 0 → {w:0,h:0}, so room = 500-0 = 500 >= |delta|=400 → NO clamp, cd = +400, coord lands at 900 (the vacant cell cedes its whole extent down to w=100). Matches project's vacant-leaf default (parcel.jq:310): a vacant cell has no floor, so the drag is free against it. valid_rec stays ok (the reserved slot still tiles its rect).
